# sarifix.yaml reference

Every key sarifix reads from `sarifix.yaml`, generated from the config schema. Unknown keys are an error. See [Configuration](../configuration.md) for a guided tour.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | int | none | Schema version. Must be 1. |
| `scanners` | list of object | none | SARIF-emitting tools sarifix can run and route findings to. |
| `rules` | object | none | Which rules may be fixed. |
| `paths` | object | none | Which files may be changed. |
| `campaigns` | list of object | none | Named migrations tracked across repos. |
| `limits` | object | none | Batch grouping and sizes, retries and time limits. |
| `verify` | object | none | How a fix is proven before it is published. |
| `agent` | object | none | The AI agent that writes fixes. |
| `publish` | object | none | How verified fixes are published. |

## `scanners[]`

SARIF-emitting tools sarifix can run and route findings to.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scanners[].name` | string | required | Unique ID, used in rule keys and branch names. |
| `scanners[].match` | list of string | `[name]` | SARIF tool.driver.name values routed to this scanner (case-insensitive). |
| `scanners[].command` | list of string | required | argv to run, no shell. Placeholders are expanded per element. |
| `scanners[].output` | string | `{out}` | Where the SARIF lands, for tools that choose their own file name. |
| `scanners[].workdir` | string | `{repo}` | Working directory for the command. |
| `scanners[].env` | map of string | none | Extra environment variables. |
| `scanners[].scope` | string | `dir` | Rescan scope during verify: changed, dir or repo. |
| `scanners[].timeout` | duration | `5m` | Time limit per invocation. |
| `scanners[].offline` | bool | `false` | Run verify rescans with the network disabled. |

## `rules`

Which rules may be fixed.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rules.allow` | list of string | none | Rule-key globs that may be fixed. Empty allows nothing. |
| `rules.deny` | list of string | none | Rule-key globs that are never fixed; wins over allow. |
| `rules.min_level` | string | `warning` | Lowest SARIF level to fix: error, warning, note or none. |

## `paths`

Which files may be changed.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `paths.deny` | list of string | `[.github/workflows/**]` | Path globs (** allowed) that are never edited. .github/workflows/** is always added. |

## `campaigns[]`

Named migrations tracked across repos.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `campaigns[].id` | string | required | Campaign ID, used as the batch key. |
| `campaigns[].scanner` | string | required | Name of the scanner that finds the old pattern. |
| `campaigns[].rules` | list of string | none | Rule-key globs in this campaign. |
| `campaigns[].pr_title` | string | none | Title for the campaign's PRs. |
| `campaigns[].labels` | list of string | none | Extra labels for the campaign's PRs. |

## `limits`

Batch grouping and sizes, retries and time limits.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limits.group_by` | string | `rule` | How findings become batches: rule (one per rule), file (one per scanner and file) or auto (one per rule, except that rules a scanner reports in only one file share a batch per file). |
| `limits.files_per_batch` | int | `10` | Most files one batch may touch. |
| `limits.findings_per_batch` | int | `25` | Most findings in one batch. |
| `limits.batches_per_run` | int | `5` | Most batches one run attempts. |
| `limits.retries` | int | `2` | Extra attempts after a failed verify. |
| `limits.max_diff_lines` | int | `400` | Largest diff the diff guard accepts. |
| `limits.agent_timeout` | duration | `10m` | Time limit for one agent call. |

## `verify`

How a fix is proven before it is published.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `verify.commands` | list of list of string | none | argv lists that must each exit 0, such as [[make, test]]. |
| `verify.require_no_new_findings` | bool | `true` | Fail when the rescan finds anything new. |

## `agent`

The AI agent that writes fixes.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agent.provider` | string | `claude-code` | Agent implementation. v1 supports claude-code. |
| `agent.model` | string | none | Model name; empty uses the provider default. |
| `agent.extra_instructions` | string | none | Repo file with conventions added to every prompt. |

## `publish`

How verified fixes are published.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `publish.pr` | object | none | Settings for --mode pr. |
| `publish.review` | object | none | Settings for --mode review. |
| `publish.issues` | object | none | Settings for --mode issues. |

### `publish.pr`

Settings for --mode pr.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `publish.pr.branch_prefix` | string | `sarifix` | Prefix for fix branches: <prefix>/<scanner>/<rule>. |
| `publish.pr.draft` | bool | `false` | Open PRs as drafts. |
| `publish.pr.labels` | list of string | `[sarifix]` | Labels added to every PR. |
| `publish.pr.reviewers_from` | string | `codeowners` | Where reviewers come from: codeowners or none. |

### `publish.review`

Settings for --mode review.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `publish.review.max_suggestions` | int | `20` | Most suggested changes in one review. |

### `publish.issues`

Settings for --mode issues.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `publish.issues.label` | string | `sarifix` | Label on every batch issue; sarifix only manages issues that carry it. |
| `publish.issues.max_open` | int | `10` | Most batch issues open at once, the most severe batches first. |
| `publish.issues.queue` | int | `0` | How many issues to keep labeled queue_label for an agent; 0 queues none. |
| `publish.issues.queue_label` | string | `agent-ready` | Label that hands an issue to an agent queue. |
